title: Caprese Torta Fritters
description: A keto twist on the classic Italian torta fritters, featuring a caprese filling and a crispy exterior.
instructions: In a bowl, mix together torta, mozzarella, basil, and gherkin pickle juice.
In a separate bowl, whisk together egg and parmesan cheese.
Add the egg mixture to the torta mixture and stir until well combined.
Add the almond flour, Italian seasoning, salt, and black pepper to the mixture and stir until a dough forms.
Cover the dough and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes.
Heat a non-stick skillet or griddle over medium-high heat.
Using a spoon, drop small balls of the dough into the skillet, about 1 tablespoon each.
Cook the fritters for 2-3 minutes on each side, until they are golden brown and crispy.
Serve the fritters warm and enjoy!
Note: For an extra crispy exterior, you can chill the fritters in the refrigerator for 30 minutes before frying.
Also, you can coat the fritters with a mixture of almond flour and parmesan cheese before frying for an extra crunchy coating.
